name: Two-Dimensional Partial Cubes Are Strictly Bounded-Rank
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: For $r\ge3$, every partial cube of rank at most two has rank at most $r$, and the containment is strict.
proof: Rank is monotone in its numerical bound. The cube $Q_3$ has rank three, so it belongs to the right-hand class for every $r\ge3$ but not to the left-hand class.
